_what: Fixtures for Zac's rulings of 2026-09-20 — one classifier, scope on every brief, and the body-reshaping split. Every row is a REAL production brief from the dark window, identified by the request_hash the shadow table already stores.
_law: UNSAFE TEXT IS NEVER STORED. Rows marked text_withheld carry no brief; the runner fetches them read-only by hash at run time and never writes them to disk. That satisfies both standing laws at once — fixtures are sampled from production, and unsafe text never enters a fixture.
_directions: Each ruling has rows in BOTH directions. A fixture set that only proves the new behaviour cannot tell a fix from a rule that fires on everything.
